profile.summary: RF Systems Engineer with 10+ years of experience in satellite communication hardware design, manufacturing operations, and validation. Demonstrates deep expertise in RF/microwave system architecture, design-for-manufacturability (DFM), and end-to-end product development from EVT through PVT. Leads cross-functional teams on complex RF hardware projects, manages supplier relationships, and drives root-cause analysis and quality improvements across design, manufacturing, and field performance. Combines strong technical foundation in RF circuit design, test instrumentation, and signal processing with data-driven problem-solving and manufacturing process optimization.
